artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan replacing all 17 bare `-- specs/` pathspec occurrences across 9 recipe files in 3 extensions with explicit file lists, plus a new standalone directory-pathspec regression lint and its both-polarity fixture test.

memory_candidates.content: When a task's scope note forbids touching any orchestrator-critical path (context/reference/orchestrator-critical-paths.json), adding a NEW lint script is admissible but WIRING it as a gate is not: scripts/verify-deploy.sh is itself critical-path entry 12. The lint ships, registers in the extension manifest's provides arrays, and is auto-discovered by scripts/tests/run-all.sh (which globs scripts/tests/test-*.sh with no registration step) -- but it is inert until a later, gate-admitting task adds the verify-deploy.sh gate. Plan for this split up front and record the gate wiring as an explicit follow-up with its reason, rather than discovering the constraint mid-implementation and either violating the scope note or silently shipping an unenforced lint.
